# agentflow fixtures

`agentflow-beta` follows the Mermaid agent flow documentation
(https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/agentflow.html), MIT licensed,
© Knut Sveidqvist and contributors; ondine's documentation for the type was
read for reference only.

- `release.mmd`, `edges.mmd`, `global-collapsed.mmd` and
  `worked-example.mmd` follow the documentation's examples.
- `cjk-styled.mmd` is written for this crate: CJK and long labels, a
  failure edge with a label, classes and styles.
